class.name: Scatter3D
class.brief_description: Copies of a mesh scattered over whatever is below a box.
class.description: Fills a box with copies of [member mesh], each dropped from the top of the box onto the first surface below it: a physics body on [member surface_mask], or a [Terrain3D]. Copies land only where the surface is no steeper than [member max_slope], turned and sized at random within the limits set here, and are drawn as one [MultiMesh], so thousands cost little. In the editor it scatters again whenever it's changed or moved, and the copies are saved with the scene, so a game doesn't place them again. A [Scatter3D] made in code scatters when it's ready; call [method scatter] to place its copies again after changing it or what's below it. Set [member collision_shape] to make the copies solid.

method.name: scatter
method.description: Places the copies again, from the current settings and whatever is below the box now. The same [member seed] places them the same way over the same surfaces.

members.member: How far copies lean with the surface they land on: [code]0.0[/code] stands them upright, [code]1.0[/code] tilts them to the surface, as a rock would lie.
The physics layers the copies are on, when [member collision_shape] is set.
A shape for each copy, placed and sized with it, to make the copies solid. They get their shapes through a [MultiMeshBody3D], so a hit reports that body.
How many copies to try for each square metre of the box's floor. Fewer land where there's no surface below or it's too steep.
The steepest surface a copy lands on, in degrees.
If [code]true[/code], each copy is turned to a random direction about its up axis.
The largest a copy is scaled, picked at random between [member scale_min] and this.
The smallest a copy is scaled, picked at random between this and [member scale_max].
Which random arrangement to place. Change it for another arrangement with the same settings.
The size of the box to fill, centred on the node. Copies land on surfaces inside it.
The physics layers of the surfaces copies land on.
